question:
For example, I would like to run the test 'date_validation' written by myself and located in folder 'generic' , where generic tests are located.

What operation can I use to run this particular test where it is mentioned?

I found this operation but it runs all generic tests : dbt test --select test_type:generic
title: How to run exact generic test in dbt by name
answer:
dbt test --select generic.date_validation
  • generic.date_validation tells dbt to run only date_validation test in generic folder.
